text: Vietjet named among Việt Nam's 50 leading brands in 2026
HCM CITY - Vietjet has been named among Forbes Việt Nam's 50 leading brands in 2026, adding to its recent recognition by the aviation industry for its hybrid airline business model.
Forbes Vietnam announced the list late last week, selecting brands based on financial performance, brand strength and competitive positioning.
The ranking recognises companies that have generated significant economic value, the publication said.
Hồ Ngọc Yến Phương, Vietjet's vice chairwoman of the board and chief financial officer, said the airline was developing a Vietnamese brand with ambitions to compete internationally.
"Vietjet is building a distinctly Vietnamese airline brand capable of competing in the international market.
With its hybrid model, we maintain our cost advantage while investing in a modern aircraft fleet and developing products and services that meet international standards," she said.
"As Vietjet's red-and-yellow aircraft reach more countries, passengers have more options to travel to and from Việt Nam and to destinations around the world," she added.
The recognition follows Vietjet's receipt of the "Asia Low Cost/Hybrid Airline of the Year" award at the CAPA Asia Aviation Leaders Summit 2026 in Hokkaido, Japan.
CAPA - Centre for Aviation presented the award in recognition of the airline's business model innovation.
Vietjet operates a network spanning Asia and Australia and is expanding its connections to Europe. - VNS
